candidates.reason: The original landscape layout is shrunk into a middle band and was not rearranged for the portrait shape. There is a large dead area above the eyebrow (~170px) and below the footer, the badge floats beside the text column on its own, and the footer sits detached in empty space.

It is restacked properly for portrait with a strong headline and CTA, but the Start Saving button is jammed tight under 'every bag' with almost no gap. The badge is pushed to the lower right, leaving a large empty block at lower left, so the balance is diagonal and lopsided. The badge does not share an edge with the text column.

The headline, eyebrow and CTA are crammed into a tiny banner row, with the headline set before 'Subscribe & Save' so the reading order is broken. The oversized House Blend badge overwhelms the message and becomes the focal point. The 'Cancel any time' footer has shrunk to an illegible speck.

It uses the same stacked layout as candidate 2 with slightly smaller type and has the same flaws. The CTA crowds right under the headline, the badge sits off to the lower right with an empty quadrant to its left, and the badge's left edge has no relationship to the text grid.
